asr_text: Both readers start with the same hope: what appears in a feed should help them understand the world. Then the stakes split. One is protecting a manageable morning and a sense of control over a personal news route. The other is protecting contact with views outside that route. Their power is not equal. One can follow, hide, or ask for more or less. The other cannot see or change the rules behind the ranking, even though those rules may shape what stays outside view.
